name: com.bloomyesim/esim
title: Bloomy eSIM
description: Travel data eSIMs, 200+ countries: plan picks from destination + days, live prices, checkout link.

tools.name: recommend_plan
tools.description: Use when a traveler asks which eSIM to get for a trip. Input: destination (or every country of a multi-country trip in destinations), trip length in days, and how they use data if known. Estimates the GB the trip needs (need_gb, same formula as estimate_data), then returns up to 3 Bloomy eSIM plans with a reason each: best_fit (lowest price in our catalog that covers the estimate), budget (cheaper, below the estimate) and roomier (next size up). A multi-country trip is matched to one regional plan that covers every country. Each option has data, validity, networks (4G/5G per carrier), top-up support, price_jpy, price_usd and price_as_of, plus purchase_url (the checkout confirmation page; the traveler pays there).

destination.description: One country or region for a single-country trip. Country name in English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Spanish or French, common names included (e.g. "Turkey", "Türkiye", "トルコ", "튀르키예", "Hawaii") or an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("TR"). Use destinations instead for several countries.

destinations.description: Every country of a multi-country trip (2 to 5 entries; names in any supported language or ISO alpha-2 codes), e.g. ["France", "Italy", "Spain"]. One eSIM that covers all of them is searched. Use instead of destination.

days.description: Required. Trip length in days, integer 1 to 180 (the whole trip for a multi-country trip). Example: 7.

usage.description: Rough data usage when activities are not known: light = maps and messaging, normal = maps, messaging, web and social (default), heavy = normal plus video streaming. Ignored when activities or min_gb is given.

activities.description: What the traveler will use mobile data for, when they say so, e.g. ["maps", "social", "video_call"]. hotspot_light / hotspot_heavy mean sharing the connection with another device. Overrides usage. Same categories as bloomyesim.com/data-calculator.

wifi.description: How often the traveler will be on hotel or cafe Wi-Fi instead of mobile data: rarely, sometimes (default) or often. More Wi-Fi lowers the estimate.

min_gb.description: Data the traveler already knows they want, in GB for the whole trip (e.g. 10). Skips the estimate; overrides usage and activities.

lang.description: Language of country names, reasons and of the checkout page the link opens: en, ja, zh-cn, zh-tw, ko, es or fr. Default en. The language never changes which plan or what price is returned: every plan carries price_jpy and price_usd (both always present) and price_as_of.

tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Use when the traveler wants to browse or compare Bloomy eSIM plans for one destination themselves. Lists plans cheapest first, single-country plans before regional ones, each with data (GB), validity (days), plan_type, networks (4G/5G), top-up support, price_jpy, price_usd, price_as_of and plan_id. Filter by trip length, minimum GB and plan type. For a recommendation with reasons, recommend_plan is the better fit.

destination.description: Required. Country name (English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Spanish or French) or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "Japan", "日本" or "JP". A country with no dedicated plan returns an error, never plans for a different country.

min_days.description: Trip length in days (integer). Fixed-GB plans valid for fewer days are skipped; daily plans are priced for this many days.

min_gb.description: Minimum data in GB, e.g. 3. For fixed-GB plans this is the total; for daily plans it is the high-speed allowance per day.

plan_type.description: "data" = a fixed amount of GB for the whole validity period; "unlimited" = daily plans priced per day (a daily high-speed allowance, then slower speed). Omit to include both.

limit.description: Maximum number of plans to return, 1 to 20. Default 8.

lang.description: Language of country names, reasons and of the checkout page the link opens: en, ja, zh-cn, zh-tw, ko, es or fr. Default en. The language never changes which plan or what price is returned: every plan carries price_jpy and price_usd (both always present) and price_as_of.

tools.name: estimate_data
tools.description: Use when the traveler asks how much data they need, without choosing a plan yet. Returns estimated_gb for the trip, estimated_daily_gb and recommended_min_gb. Same formula as bloomyesim.com/data-calculator: daily MB per activity x days x Wi-Fi factor x 1.15 safety buffer, rounded up.

days.description: Required. Trip length in days, integer 1 to 180.

activities.description: Required. What mobile data will be used for, e.g. ["maps", "messaging", "video"]. hotspot_light / hotspot_heavy mean sharing the connection with another device.

wifi.description: How often hotel or cafe Wi-Fi replaces mobile data: rarely, sometimes (default) or often.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Use to check whether Bloomy eSIM has plans for a place, or to list all destinations. Returns countries with a dedicated plan: ISO code, localized name, number of plans and the lowest price (from_jpy, from_usd). Many more countries are covered by regional plans (200+ countries and regions in total).

query.description: Part of a country name or ISO code to filter by, e.g. "tur" or "TR". Omit to list all.

lang.description: Language of country names, reasons and of the checkout page the link opens: en, ja, zh-cn, zh-tw, ko, es or fr. Default en. The language never changes which plan or what price is returned: every plan carries price_jpy and price_usd (both always present) and price_as_of.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Use for questions about one plan returned by another tool. Details of one Bloomy eSIM plan by plan_id: data, validity, when validity starts, network (4G/5G) and carriers per country, top-up support, price_jpy, price_usd, price_as_of and the checkout link.

plan_id.description: Required. The plan_id from recommend_plan or search_plans, e.g. 14085.

days.description: Trip length in days. For daily plans it sets the number of days and the total price; ignored for fixed-GB plans.

lang.description: Language of country names, reasons and of the checkout page the link opens: en, ja, zh-cn, zh-tw, ko, es or fr. Default en. The language never changes which plan or what price is returned: every plan carries price_jpy and price_usd (both always present) and price_as_of.

tools.name: get_purchase_link
tools.description: Use when the traveler has chosen a plan and wants to buy it. Returns a link straight to the checkout confirmation screen with the plan and days filled in. The traveler pays there themselves (no account or app needed, just an email address); this tool never takes payment. The QR code and one-tap install link are emailed and shown in My Page right after payment.

plan_id.description: Required. The plan_id of the chosen plan, from recommend_plan or search_plans.

days.description: Trip length in days. Needed for daily plans (sets how many days are bought); ignored for fixed-GB plans.

lang.description: Language of country names, reasons and of the checkout page the link opens: en, ja, zh-cn, zh-tw, ko, es or fr. Default en. The language never changes which plan or what price is returned: every plan carries price_jpy and price_usd (both always present) and price_as_of.

tools.name: get_setup_guide
tools.description: Use for questions about compatibility, installing or connecting. Short setup steps for iPhone or Android (no app to download: install from the QR code or one-tap link in the phone settings), what to check before buying, and links to the full guide, the device checker and troubleshooting.

device.description: The traveler's phone: iphone or android. Default iphone.

lang.description: Language of country names, reasons and of the checkout page the link opens: en, ja, zh-cn, zh-tw, ko, es or fr. Default en. The language never changes which plan or what price is returned: every plan carries price_jpy and price_usd (both always present) and price_as_of.
